customer_reply:
Hi,

Thank you for reaching out. Our spend analytics currently only supports flat cost‑center grouping; hierarchical roll‑ups (Division > Dept > Team) are not available. This limitation is documented in our knowledge base (KB‑S05). The feature is tracked on our roadmap (PM‑1190), and you can submit a formal request through the Customer Portal if you’d like us to prioritize it.

In the meantime, you can continue using the flat list view or export the data and perform the hierarchy aggregation in an external tool such as Excel or Power BI.

Please let us know if you have any other questions.

Best regards,
Support Team
